summary.added_external_crate_count_note: P2-N5 admits no external crate. academic-gap links academic-domain, academic-freshness, academic-knowledge-state, serde and thiserror as product edges, and academic-capture, academic-consent, academic-lecture-document, academic-model-run, academic-policy, academic-repository, academic-repository-analysis, academic-repository-classification, academic-repository-correlation, academic-transcription, academic-untrusted-content, serde_json, tempfile, trybuild and uuid as dev edges, all covered by earlier reviewed receipts, and adds one workspace path package. Nothing links into a product binary that was not already there: the three workspace product edges are path packages this repository already builds, and serde and thiserror were admitted by the phase 1 receipt. Build-time-only additions are zero -- there is no build script, no proc macro beyond serde's and thiserror's, and no code generator.
summary.added_workspace_path_package_note: academic-gap is the P2-N5 boundary: section 15's definition of a gap as an evidence-backed prerequisite deficit blocking an active goal, the five gap kinds of section 15.2's table, the four state dimensions its third step overlays, the descent to the first strong deficit with its ancestor impact, the root candidates it retains rather than chooses between, and section 15.3's eight-field explanation contract with the validator that refuses advice too broad to act on. It is a separate package from academic-knowledge-state and academic-freshness because the restraint section 15.1 demands is then a graph fact rather than a rule: nothing in either of those crates can produce a GapCase, and nothing here can produce one without an ActiveGoal. It is a separate package from academic-domain because it reads P2-N2's admission decision and P2-N3's band, which academic-domain sits below and cannot depend on without a cycle.

no_second_ladder_note: Section 7.2's twenty predicates and the prerequisite column that says which two a path engine may traverse were fixed by P2-C1's predicate registry, and this crate declares no second allowlist: PrerequisiteEdge::admit calls prerequisite_descriptor, which refuses the other eighteen including RELATED_TO, and asks the descriptor which strengths that predicate admits, which is what makes 강한 BUILDS_ON mean BuildsOn at Strong. PrerequisiteStrength's three values are that registry's and strength_token is a total match over them rather than a fourth enumeration. EntityKind's five ontology tiers were fixed by P2-C3 and gap_bearing is a total match over them, so the refusal of a FIELD subject is that crate's own carries no independent prerequisite of its own rather than a list of broad phrases here. MasteryLevel and its ladder were fixed by P2-N2 and this crate compares through that crate's rung; FreshnessBand and its six bands were fixed by P2-C1 and this crate compares through P2-N3's rank. Section 14's six question statuses were fixed by P2-N4 and a tie diagnostic references one without constructing, resolving or reopening any. The three counts section 15 fixes -- five gap kinds, four state dimensions, eight explanation fields -- are each measured against the design document in both directions rather than restated as numbers, and section 15.2 step 6's four informal names are kept beside the table's five rows so that discrepancy is a recorded measurement rather than something a later reader rediscovers.

direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-domain: EntityId, EvidenceId, ScopeId, ConfidencePermille, MasteryLevel, FreshnessBand, entity_registry::EntityKind, predicates::{PredicateName, PrerequisiteStrength, prerequisite_descriptor} and question::QuestionStatus. The predicate registry is what admits a traversal edge, so section 15.2 step 2's REQUIRES와 강한 BUILDS_ON is that crate's prerequisite column refusing eighteen rows rather than a list here. EntityKind is what refuses a FIELD subject, in P2-C3's own words. QuestionStatus is P2-N4's, and it is read and never written.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-freshness: FreshnessProjection, FreshnessSignal, Spillover, rank and BANDS. Section 15.2 step 3's second dimension is P2-N3's band, and this crate reads a projection rather than computing one. The Spillover edge is the one that needed a reason and the receipt carries it: section 13.3 licenses a spillover on REQUIRES, BUILDS_ON, RELATED_TO and SPECIAL_CASE_OF, and two of those four are the edges this engine descends, so a band raised by a neighbour on the node's own blocking path is the surface concept's evidence deciding its own prerequisite's deficit. search refuses one with FreshnessRestsOnPathSpillover naming the neighbour and the edge; ConceptState::overlay carries the SpilloverSource that makes the refusal possible and compares the declared contributions against the projection's own trace so none can be hidden.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-knowledge-state: ConceptEvidence, ConceptLink, EligibilityOutcome, EligibleEvidence, EvidenceDossier, EvidenceSufficiency, SufficiencyGap, UnseenBasis, project and rung. Two of the four overlay dimensions are this crate's. What the edge brings that a ready-made projection would not is the point: academic_knowledge_state::project accepts a slice of EligibleEvidence about two concepts and returns a MasteryProjection carrying neither, so ConceptState::overlay takes the inputs to section 13.4's four checks and runs EligibilityOutcome::admit itself. The admitted half is checked against EligibleEvidence::concept and the blocked half against the dossier's own link, because BlockedEvidence does not retain one -- two guards over disjoint halves, neither able to stand in for the other.

dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-capture: P2-L2's begin, its journal and its preflight readings, reached through P2-N2's fixture module, so the manifest a document is built over is the file the real capture surface wrote.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-consent: P2-L2's consent ledger, capture request and permission scope, because a capture that is not permitted writes no journal and the fixture must pass the same gate a real one does.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-lecture-document: LectureDocument and NodeId, so section 13.2's first row -- the exposure this suite's gap fixtures rest on -- is a node of a document P2-L4 produced rather than a string this suite invented.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-model-run: CalibrationRegistry and its dataset types, which P2-L3's confidence interpretation requires before a segment exists.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-policy: ContentDigest, for the analysis policy hash a P2-R1 snapshot request carries.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository: P2-R1's capture_local and SnapshotRequest, reached through P2-N2's fixture module.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-analysis: P2-R2's EvidenceLadder and Finding, reached through the same module.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-classification: P2-R4's ConceptStance, which P2-N2's fixture module reads.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-correlation: P2-R3's correlate, the only route from findings to the relation edges P2-R4 reads.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-transcription: P2-L3's run, its provider contract and its transcript lineage, so a document node maps a segment of a real transcript.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-untrusted-content: SourceIndex, which P2-R1's capture_local returns and P2-R2's AnalysisInput::of checks every unit against.
dev_workspace_dependencies.serde_json: gap_case_round_trip. Section 15.1's GapCase is a schema, so the round trip is driven through a real encoder and the decoded value is required to re-run every constructor check -- a candidate-less case and a case whose candidates leave the surface are both refused on the way in.
dev_workspace_dependencies.tempfile: The directory a P2-L2 journal is written to. It is a dev edge only; no product file of this crate names it or any other filesystem type.
dev_workspace_dependencies.trybuild: The compile-fail suite. Section 15's limits are types, and the eight cases under crates/gap/tests/compile_fail assert that each refusal is a program that does not compile with a committed diagnostic. The cases live in this package rather than in academic-scenario's suite for the reason P2-N2 gives: this crate reaches academic-knowledge-state, which reaches academic-ledger, and scenario_crate_has_no_writer_dependency refuses academic-scenario that crate through a dev edge as much as a product one.
dev_workspace_dependencies.uuid: Deterministic UUIDv7-shaped fixture identities. Every identifier in the suite is a SHA-256 of the fixture's own name with the version and variant nibbles set, so no identity is a function of a clock.

why_this_dependency_belongs_inside_its_t: academic-gap is a workspace path crate, not an external dependency. It owns section 15's gap engine and, for each rule, the value that does not exist rather than the check somebody has to remember to run: no function produces a GapCase without an ActiveGoal, so a low knowledge state that no active goal's prerequisite path reaches has no function to be passed to; GoalCriteria has no Default and its one constructor returns None for an empty list, so step 2's expansion has nothing to run from until step 1 has happened; blocking_floor answers None for HELPFUL, so a weak BUILDS_ON has no rung to compare against and the descent has nothing to cross; ConceptState::overlay takes the inputs to section 13.4's four checks rather than a ready-made projection, and refuses evidence, a projection or a contribution naming another concept; GapCase::of refuses a tie with no diagnostic rather than choosing a root, which is the discipline P2-R4's ClassificationConflict, P2-R3's ImplementationDrift and P2-N2's conflict card already set; and GapExplanation::of refuses a broad recommendation on eight structural facts with no text comparison anywhere in the crate, which the_gap_crate_holds_no_phrase_list observes as a whole-set comparison of every non-ASCII literal in the package against the design document's own cells plus a whole-text pin on defects. Its dependency set is minimal and the edges it does not have are the point: no academic-store, so no gap reaches the canonical writer and no migration is added; no academic-worker and no academic-egress-boundary, so nothing in its closure can launch a process or stage a payload.
network_posture: The crate opens no socket, opens no file, reads no clock, declares no foreign function, reads no environment variable, spawns no process, and runs no build script. It spells no std::fs, std::net, std::process, std::env or std::time name at all: every instant arrives inside a P2-N3 value. the_gap_crate_holds_no_phrase_list and no_clock_socket_or_file_reaches_this_crate in crates/gap/tests/gap_scans.rs compare the whole set of its 59 use items, the whole set of the 7 two-segment paths it reaches through a crate root, the whole set of the 2 macros it invokes and the 10 modules lib.rs re-exports from against pinned inventories in both directions, and run a whole-identifier pass for fifteen filesystem, clock, process and transport constructs over every product file. Twenty injections that spell none of the forbidden tokens were each compiled and each observed failing a named test: the two concept guards removed one at a time, the path-spillover guard neutralised, the trace comparison dropped, a rung given to a helpful BUILDS_ON, EVIDENCE_GAP promoted to a strong deficit, the retrieval floor lowered a band, a tie resolved by taking one root, an undated remediation admitted, a FIELD subject admitted at the validator and again at its source, P2-C4's prerequisite gate bypassed, one helpful edge read as a branch, the descent continued through an unsettled identity, one recorded failure ignored, the confidence half of the evidence-gap rule dropped, a blank reason cell admitted, any activity shape admitted as a tie diagnostic, a zero-hop explanation admitted, and the ancestor's weakest link reported as its strongest. Its link closure holds nothing that can open a socket beyond libc, which reaches it through academic-policy by way of academic-knowledge-state. Every document, capture, transcript, snapshot, claim and projection in its test tree is synthetic and built in process; no real lecture or repository is read and no network call is made.
advisory_path: Unchanged. Every external crate academic-gap links was admitted by an earlier receipt and is triaged through that receipt's advisory path. serde and thiserror were admitted by the phase 1 receipt; serde_json, tempfile, trybuild and uuid are already-admitted dev dependencies of other workspace packages. .github/dependabot.yml opens no version-update pull request.
